title: From Dogwhistles to Bullhorns: Unveiling Coded Rhetoric with Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Diachronic analysis of dogwhistle frequency in historical political speeches, prompting language models (GPT-3) to surface and define covert meanings of racist dogwhistles, and substituting dogwhistles for standard group labels or slurs in hateful sentence templates to evaluate evasion of Perspective API's toxicity detection.

Prompting language models to surface and identify the covert meanings of antisemitic dogwhistles, and comparing toxicity detection scores of hateful sentences using antisemitic dogwhistles versus explicit group labels and slurs.

Prompting language models to surface and identify the covert meanings of transphobic dogwhistles, and evaluating toxicity detection models on hateful templates containing transphobic dogwhistles versus explicit slurs or standard group labels.
Evaluating GPT-3's ability to recall and define the covert meanings of Islamophobic dogwhistles using definition-based prompting with and without context cues.
Prompting language models (GPT-3) to identify the covert meanings of homophobic dogwhistles from a curated glossary.
